claims.text: Baseline methods include NaiveNN and FANN, which train sentiment classifiers solely on the source domain.
Naive is a non-domain-adaptive baseline that uses bag-of-words representations and an SVM classifier trained on the source domain.
mSDA is mentioned as a state-of-the-art method based on discrete input features.
